subject: physics
question_text: Define gravitational potential energy. Write its expression for a body of mass m at a distance r from a body of mass M.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The definition
lines: The gravitational potential energy of a body at
a point is the work done in bringing the body
steps.why: Infinity is chosen as the zero because that is the only distance at which the pull genuinely vanishes.
common_mistakes: Defining it as m g h, which is only the near-surface special case.

recall.must_convey: That it is the work done in bringing the body from infinity to that point.
accept: work done bringing it from infinity
reject: minus G M m by r

steps.label: The expression
lines: It is NEGATIVE because the pull does the work
as the body comes inward, and U is taken as
steps.why: A negative energy means the system is BOUND: work has to be put in to get the body back out to infinity.
common_mistakes: Dropping the minus sign, which would describe two masses that repel.

recall.must_convey: That U equals minus G M m by r, negative because U is zero at infinity.
accept: minus G M m by r
reject: work done bringing it from infinity
